main_text.p: lentus,acerbus,asper.Item Substantivè:amaritudo, amarum, Iesa. 38.15.17.&5.20. Plural. מְרִירִין, Syrè,
[Syriac and Hebrew entries, partly illegible] Foem. מְרִירְתָּא, Amara,Pl. מְרִירָן.
מְרָרָא, מְרָר, מְרָר Ch. Amaritudo,amarum.Plur. מְרָרִין A-maritudines, amara, res amarae,Exo.12.8.
מְרוֹר Ch.Amaror.Plur. מְרוֹרָהא Amaritudines eorum Thren.1.5.
מְרִירוּתָא, מְרִירוּת Ch. [Syriac] Syr. Amarulentia, Amaritudo.
מְרִירְתָּא, מְרִירָא, מְרִירָא Ch. Fel, Bilis, ab amaritudine sic dicta:Item Virus, Venenum.
מרש מְרִישָא, מָרִישׁ Chald. Trabs magna, Tignum, מְרִישָא אָעֵי אַרְזָיָא Trabes lignorum cedrinorum, 1. Reg.6.36.
משח Chald. & Syr. Ungere, inungere, ut Hebraicè: Deinde Ch. Metiri, dimetiri, mensurare. Affine est Germ Messen.
מְשִׁיחָא מְשִׁיחָא Ch & Syr Unctus; Synecdochicè, Christus,Mesias, Salvator promissus. Plur. מְשִׁיחִין.

page.notes: Syriac and Hebrew script is printed throughout; the vowel-pointed Hebrew and Syriac forms are transcribed only approximately, and the Syriac words are marked as illegible where I could not read them letter by letter. The entry with the large מרש and the Germ. word in black letter is partly uncertain.
